claim.statement: Marvell Semiconductor (which acquired Celestial AI) cancelled all of POET Technologies' Celestial AI purchase orders — written notice given 2026-04-23, POET announced 2026-04-27 — citing alleged POET breach of confidentiality obligations. This terminates the POET→Celestial optical-engine supply channel and, by extension, cuts Sivers' indirect route to Celestial/Marvell AI demand via POET (Sivers→POET→Celestial).
